answer: Prayers & Duties >> Jumuah & Eid Prayers Question ID: 55725 Country: India Title: Juma salah Question: As I am working in a private company, it is difficult to offer Jumuah namaz by Jamat, so I am offering Zuhr namaz instead of Jumuah, please suggest. Answer ID: 55725 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1461/1473/N=12/1435) You should discuss the owner of the company and perform Jumuah salah in the mosque on Friday. If he deducts some money from your salary or asks you to do overtime work as a result of it then you should agree to it. In short, it is not lawful to miss Jumuah due to employment in case your company falls under the Shariah boundary of any city, town or big village. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
